cases.name: Laura Nayeli Aceves
cases.about:
Laura attended Berryville Schools and worked at the Berryville Tyson Foods plant, where she worked on an assembly line deboning chicken.

In 2015, Arkansas Gov. Asa Hutchinson (R) signed a bill on Wednesday requiring police to screen domestic abuse victims to assess their risk of being killed in a domestic homicide, a proactive step that aims to reduce lethal intimate partner violence.

The legislation, called “Laura’s Law,” is named after Laura Aceves.
cases.narrative: She was found in her apartment with a gunshot wound to her head. Her four-month-old son was crying by her side, coated in so much blood that EMTs thought he’d been shot too.
